description: Modoc - Heather Hadwick, a farmer, small business owner, and community leader announced her candidacy for the California Assembly District 1. Raised in the small town of Dorris in Siskiyou County, Heather Hadwick's roots in rural Northern California run deep. Together with her family, she operates a successful farm in Modoc County, specializing in hay, vegetables, and pumpkins, while also raising highland cattle.
